source.split_rule: use recorded C1-02 split and root group unchanged

features.position_scaling: (p-C1-02_train_mean_m)/C1-02_train_std_m, population std ddof=0; reject nonpositive std
features.quaternion: C1-02 canonical unit wxyz, unchanged; reject noncanonical/nonfinite
features.q_current_scaling: (q_current-lower)/(upper-lower), frozen six joint limits; no wrapping or clamp

target.supervised_mask: label_present=true; missing wide rows remain in inventory and geometry evaluation
target.output_head: unbounded linear six-vector in normalized joint coordinates
target.loss: sum squared normalized joint error over 6, then mean over labeled rows; dimensionless
target.q_error_report: per-row mean absolute joint error in rad and per-row joint L2 in rad; report median/p95 by split and mode

training.seed_protocol: set Python random, NumPy and torch.manual_seed to training seed before model init; use separate NumPy PCG64(seed) permutation of fixed pair_id-sorted labeled train rows each epoch; same permutation for both models; deterministic torch algorithms; CPU single thread; no DataLoader workers
training.accumulation: if needed split each effective batch and backprop each micro-batch loss weighted by micro_count/effective_batch_count; optimizer step once per effective batch including final partial batch
training.epoch_coverage: all 15204 labeled train rows exactly once per epoch, including final partial effective batch; no drop_last
training.validation: after every epoch on all 3249 labeled validation rows in fixed pair_id order, no gradient; record loss by mode and overall
training.checkpoint_selection: strict lowest finite overall labeled validation mean loss; exact tie keeps earliest epoch; compare using full-precision float64 aggregated sum/count of float32 per-row loss
training.early_stop: Each E-C03 control/intervention pair: BOTH labeled-validation-q counters >=20, or 200 epochs; same epochs/steps per pair. E-C04/05 use a fresh E-C03 comparator with the same paired rule. Record all duplicate comparator runs; never cherry-pick them.
training.nonfinite: abort run and retain evidence; never select NaN or Inf checkpoint
training.initialization: Fresh initialization with identical seed and tensor states per pair; no warm-start. Hash initial state and each epoch permutation. Historical C1-04 remains separate.
training.fit_rows: 15204 labeled train rows ONLY for ALL terms in primary comparisons. 1596 unlabeled train rows remain inventory; adding them to FK would change the training inventory and is excluded.

loss.length_source: ADR-005 manufacturer maximum reach; not fitted from data
loss.units: dimensionless losses; physical q radians; p metres; LR chordal, not geodesic degrees
loss.scaling: NO additional mean over coordinates, NO learned scale, NO lambda schedule
loss.quaternion: canonical wxyz to rotation matrix; R(u)==R(-u); model input canonicalized as C1-04

search.selection: one predeclared candidate per arm; equal control opportunity; all three seeds reported
search.primary: Profile A success count / 3600; seed-paired absolute count and percentage-point differences
search.checkpoint: best labeled validation Lq, same C1-04 rule; NEVER replace by best FK-success epoch
candidate_order: higher mean Profile A across seeds
simpler model Q then FK then FK_LIMIT then FK_TANH
search.failure: nonfinite/invalid graph/hash/technical gate -> FAIL, not candidate deletion or extra trial; pilot failure blocks full training
search.best_seed: no cherry-pick: retain every seed; any C1-06 deployment witness uses predeclared seed 2026100201

pilot.selection: 32 train/16 validation labeled rows in each family x mode, lexicographic IDs; fixed before results
logs: Lq/Lp/LR/Llim unweighted and weighted per epoch and mode
per-component raw output gradient norm and every Linear weight/bias norm
combined gradient norm; NaN/Inf counts; parameter update norm
all raw q, FK-input q and evaluation q; out-of-limits count/rate
target/prediction geodesic angle >=175 degrees count; LR and gradient there
validation geometric metrics; no validation backprop
pilot.gate: all values finite; isolated p/R gradients nonzero on nonstationary fixed fixtures; autograd/FD tests pass; zero-lambda equals Q loss/grad; decomposition matches; shuffled labels rejected; units/frame/sign controls pass; raw==FK==evaluation; resource caps pass
pilot.scales: report all measured ratios including extreme imbalance; inspect against exact formulas and fixed lambdas; no automatic retuning. Unexplained discrepancy blocks full run; new weights require new registration.

extension_gate.domain: 32 interior + 48 controlled out-of-limit configurations, forward and gradient on every sample
extension_gate.reference: independent direct Pinocchio model and analytic fixtures; existing public adapters unchanged
extension_gate.stress: float32/64 finfo.max and -max on each joint: finite output only, no FD/accuracy claim at extreme range

evaluation.fit_q_loss: only 3249 labeled validation; same normalized sum-joints loss
evaluation.raw: finite and strict joint limits; no projection; raw invalid always failure in Profile A/B
evaluation.reference: existing independent PinocchioFK, valid raw only; IndependentFK spot checks
evaluation.valid_only: explicit valid N beside conditional quantiles; historical C1-04 same conditional metric
evaluation.full_denominator: invalid geometry assigned +inf for conservative empirical quantiles (nearest-rank ceil(p*N)); serialize inf as null plus unbounded=true. Never omit invalids. Also report finite geometry coverage N/3600.
evaluation.comparison: pair_id and seed paired counts; absolute m/degree and success-count deltas; per-seed values plus mean/std/min/max; three seeds exploratory

variants.E_C04: compare FK vs FK_LIMIT, unbounded; fresh paired reruns, identical initialization/order/budget
variants.E_C05: compare FK vs FK_TANH with lambda_lim=0 both; same six linear logits, tanh applied only as head; fresh paired reruns
variants.tanh_monitor: each joint fraction abs(tanh(z))>=0.99, dq/dz=(upper-lower)/2*(1-tanh(z)**2); boundary target rows separate
variants.E_C06: SKIP: prioritize FK/limit attribution in first wave; requires separate quaternion vs 6D preregistration
variants.E_C07: SKIP: prioritize FK/limit attribution; absolute q fixed, no delta effect claimed
variants.E_C08: SKIP: second-wave metric/gradient stability prerequisite; no inverse manipulability loss
variants.singularity: existing target source_family metric always reported; predicted scaled minimum singular value diagnostic after valid FK, no penalty
variants.Res_MLP: SKIP: extra capacity confounds first comparison; separate ADR required
variants.curriculum: SKIP: fixed weights only; separate schedule/config required

resources.platform: Windows x64 CPU; existing C1-03 hash-locked overlay
resources.budget: E-C03 2 arms x3 seeds; E-C04 fresh 2 arms x3; E-C05 conditional fresh 2 arms x3. No new unique config from repeated comparators.
resources.storage: LOCAL_ONLY; remote_archive NOT_CONFIRMED; path/bytes/SHA/metadata/accessible per checkpoint; no normal Git weights
resources.retention: all failed attempts retained; atomic save; no overwrite; verify bytes on reload and clean checkout
